description: Finger IIIB C-414, a 1982 veteran of the Escuadrón Aeromóvil Dagger 'Avutardas Salvajes' that flew from Río Grande; flown back in a C-130 and photographed at the naval air base 7 November 2022, destined for the monuments area of the city (reported March 2025). Exact final position needs on-site confirmation.
museum_name: Dagger C-414 Avutardas Salvajes Monument, Río Grande
